messages:
marta: Heads up — spotted a 404 in the runtime guide. The KV cache page links to an S3 path that 404s in prod. Anyone owns docs/runtime/kv-cache.md?

alex: Not on my plate. Can you paste the failing link so I can poke at it?

marta: Sure — the broken reference is in the "best practices" section: https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache.md#prefix-caching -> ends up redirecting to s3://redwood-internal/kvcache/guide.md which 404s. Also the inline image `kv-diagram.png` returns 403 on staging.

samir: I can take this. Sounds like an internal-bucket reference that needs rehosting to the public CDN. I'll open a small PR to replace the s3 path and re-upload the image to cdn-redwood.

linkbot: :warning: link-scan result: 404 detected in /docs/runtime/kv-cache.md. Issue created: #421 (autogenerated).

marta: Thanks @samir. The 403 is only on staging preview, prod shows 404 for the s3 link. Probably IAM mismatch during deploy. Rehosting is safest.

alex: If you're doing a quick replace, easiest is a one-liner: 

```bash
sed -i 's|s3://redwood-internal/|https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/|g' docs/runtime/kv-cache.md
```

and then `git add` + push. Also update the image path and run `make site-preview` to validate.

samir: Will do that. I'll also add a note in the PR about why we rehosted (internal bucket -> public CDN) and link the issue. ETA ~2h. :hourglass: 

sofia: I can review once it's up. Also double-check license for the diagram asset before rehost; if it's generated internals we should regenerate a neutral diagram.

samir: Good call — I'll check license and if needed recreate a simplified SVG. Assigning review to @sofia in the PR. PR preview link (placeholder): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234

marta: Awesome, thanks for picking this up. Ping here when PR is ready and I'll claim the owner-check step for the runtime guide. :thumbsup:

sofia: Will review quickly when posted. If anyone needs me earlier, ping DM.
